description.value: Tracycakes Bakery Cafe is a charming from-scratch bakery and cafe that has been baking daily since 2006, known for over 60 varieties of cupcakes, elegant Signature High Teas, and savoury lunch items including paninis, soups, and wraps. The Abbotsford location features both indoor and outdoor seating and is part of the Downtown Abby Hospitality Collective, making it a welcoming stop in a locally-focused dining neighbourhood. A touring cyclist can eat in or take out, and online pre-orders for pick-up are also available.
